auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalLabel: Stay both-hands. No merge, no champion.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Stay both-hands. No merge, no champion."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Tāwhiri Ngata ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
